P1: The search covered only the last 12 days (status partial), though 30 days were requested. The 120 refunds all went to cards from one country, but days 13–30 were never evaluated. So we cannot say that no refunds went to other countries over the full 30 days. Cannot tell.

P2: The link took effect at 09:40 Monday, before the 10:00 scoring. But it was learned at 15:00 Monday, so the system did not have it when scoring. The evidence was not available to the check at 10:00. The answer is No.

P3: Refunds rising from 1 to 6 percent in a week is a sixfold jump. Together with the closed-account link, this warrants review. A review is a reasonable response to the observed rise, and the question does not require proof of abuse. Yes.

RESULT PN-002 | P1: Cannot tell | P2: No | P3: Yes
